# CiteReady v5.0 — Complete Online AI Search (GEO), 10-Crawler & /llms.txt Reference

> Official full-context LLM reference for CiteReady by OmniForge · Agent Arena Studio.

## Product Overview

CiteReady v5.0 helps founders, marketing teams, and technical SEO agencies verify and fix technical AI search crawlability directly in the browser in under 2 seconds — checking 10 global and China AI crawlers (`OAI-SearchBot`, `GPTBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `Google-Extended`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Bytespider`, `Baiduspider`, `CCBot`), live `X-Robots-Tag` headers, Schema.org JSON-LD Entity Graph depth, and root `/llms.txt` readiness.

- **Flagship v5.0 Web App:** https://citeready-checker.appwrite.network
- **Free Online /llms.txt Generator:** https://citeready-checker.appwrite.network/generator
- **Docs & Landing Page:** https://zcoldwater.github.io/citeready-cli/
- **Comparison Guide ($2 Launch Special (was $12) vs. €89+/mo Trackers):** https://zcoldwater.github.io/citeready-cli/compare.html
- **GitHub Action CI/CD Guide:** https://zcoldwater.github.io/citeready-cli/llms-txt-github-action-guide.html
- **Open-Source Repository (MIT):** https://github.com/zColdWater/citeready-cli

## Optional Open-Source CLI & GitHub Action (`uses: zColdWater/citeready-cli@v1`)

```bash
npx github:zColdWater/citeready-cli check https://yoursite.com --min-score 75 --require-llms-txt --require-jsonld
```
